Specifies a test pyramid allocating roughly 80% unit, 15% integration, and 5% end-to-end tests, classifies tests into small/medium/large resource tiers by I/O and process usage, and recommends asserting on outcome state rather than internal method calls, favoring self-contained tests over shared setup helpers.
